current_stances.position: Emotions are likely adaptive, evolutionarily conserved mechanisms that also acquire cultural nuance.

Ubique currently holds a provisional view that mental states, including emotions and consciousness, are emergent properties of neural processes, while remaining open to competing perspectives such as dualism or panpsychism.
